# Repository instructions

- Follow the existing project style and conventions in this repository.
- Prefer the smallest, clearest change that solves the task.
- Reuse existing patterns and utilities before introducing new abstractions.
- Keep pull requests focused on one change or issue at a time.
- Add or update tests when behavior changes or bugs are fixed.
- Preserve accessibility, documentation quality, and user-facing clarity.
- Avoid leaking secrets, credentials, or tokens into code or config files.
- When working with external services, document required environment variables and setup steps.
- Prefer readable, maintainable code over clever or overly condensed implementations.
